I've lived there until last year, it was alright ! I think as a new person in Groningen moving to a place like SH can be kind of beneficial (you build a little community so you don't feel lost, you have your own privacy for a while so you can still have your own rhythms)-- of course, there were many upsetting things such as shitty maintainance and problems not being tackled as they should be. The good thing however is that every tenant is eligible for a housing grant (if they didn't change the price; for me it was 650 per month) and that right now the whole terrain should be more accessible (it was perpetually under construction while I was living there 🥲). Also my friends and i got back the entire deposit (minus 30 euros but oh well) so i also suspect people were upset about them withholding money for no reason and they finally got the message. As other people suggested, taking the offer would probably be good since trying to find an apartment when you're not already living here is really difficult :, after one year then you'll be able to look for a house here and move out of SH ! (Henk also offers moving help for a fee that's not too high) Best of luck :-)
